_comment: Canned machine-block matcher for G4's fixture loop pass (tiny weaving domain). Semantically coherent: spindle_b lacks any tunes edge (the FIX-003/FIX-005 recurring class); the anchor is spindle_a's existing tunes edge; the fix mints spindle_b -tunes-> dye_bath_2 at declared 0.75.
statement: A spindle catalogued without any tunes edge inherits its nearest sibling spindle's dye-bath tuning relation, written for its own mechanics.
signature_sql: SELECT s.strand_id FROM strands s WHERE s.strand_kind='spindle' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ties t WHERE t.tie_from = s.strand_id AND t.tie_kind = 'tunes')

confirm.sql: SELECT 1 FROM ties WHERE tie_kind='tunes' LIMIT 1
confirm._why: an anchor tunes edge must already be frozen — pattern-completion, not invention

confirm.sql: SELECT 1 FROM strands WHERE strand_id='spindle_b' AND strand_kind='spindle'
confirm._why: the candidate is a real catalogued spindle, not a phantom

fix.pairs_sql: SELECT s.strand_id, 'dye_bath_2' FROM strands s WHERE s.strand_kind='spindle' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ties t WHERE t.tie_from = s.strand_id AND t.tie_kind = 'tunes')

properties_template.rationale: tension class inferred from sibling spindle's tuning anchor (dual-grounded)
